setup: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const path=require('path');const src=path.join(process.env.PASEO_SOURCE_CHECKOUT_PATH,'packages/server/.env');const dest=path.join(process.env.PASEO_WORKTREE_PATH,'packages/server/.env');if(fs.existsSync(src)){fs.copyFileSync(src,dest);}else{console.log('No packages/server/.env found in source checkout; skipping copy.');}"

app.command: cd packages/app && BROWSER=none EXPO_PUBLIC_LOCAL_DAEMON="localhost:${PASEO_SERVICE_DAEMON_PORT}" npx expo start --port $PASEO_PORT

tailnet dev daemon.command: TS_HOST="$(tailscale status --json | node -e 'let s="";process.stdin.on("data",d=>s+=d);process.stdin.on("end",()=>{const j=JSON.parse(s);console.log((j.Self.DNSName||"").replace(/\.$/,""));});')" && export PASEO_HOME="${PASEO_HOME:-$HOME/paseo-dev-local}" && mkdir -p "$PASEO_HOME" && PASSWORD_FILE="${PASEO_DEV_PASSWORD_FILE:-$HOME/.paseo-dev-password}" && if [ ! -r "$PASSWORD_FILE" ]; then echo "Missing password file: $PASSWORD_FILE" >&2; exit 1; fi && export PASEO_PASSWORD="$(tr -d '\r\n' < "$PASSWORD_FILE")" && PASEO_LISTEN="127.0.0.1:${PASEO_PORT}" PASEO_HOSTNAMES="$TS_HOST" PASEO_CORS_ORIGINS="http://$TS_HOST:${PASEO_SERVICE_TAILNET_DEV_APP_PORT},https://$TS_HOST,https://$TS_HOST:${PASEO_SERVICE_TAILNET_DEV_APP_PORT}" ./scripts/dev-daemon.sh

tailnet dev app.command: TS_HOST="$(tailscale status --json | node -e 'let s="";process.stdin.on("data",d=>s+=d);process.stdin.on("end",()=>{const j=JSON.parse(s);console.log((j.Self.DNSName||"").replace(/\.$/,""));});')" && cd packages/app && BROWSER=none APP_VARIANT=development EXPO_PUBLIC_LOCAL_DAEMON="$TS_HOST:${PASEO_SERVICE_TAILNET_DEV_DAEMON_PORT}" npx expo start --host lan --port "$PASEO_PORT" --clear
